title: Reinstatement Expense Payment Basis, Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
Repossession and Collateral Recovery payment basis for the expense side of a reinstatement.

> The reinstatement expense payment is the case's posted recovery expenses not yet removed or settled, plus the storage the payment covers.
>
> The storage the reinstatement expense payment covers runs through the payment date, or through the latest earliest sale date stated in any notice of intent to sell on the case when that date is earlier; the days held are the calendar days from the day after the recovery date through that end date, the class free days are deducted from the days held, the chargeable days never fall below zero nor exceed the class maximum of chargeable days, and each chargeable day is charged at the class storage fee per day.
>
> The reinstatement expense payment is assembled in this fixed order: the days not charged are deducted from the days held, the remainder is floored at zero and then limited to the class maximum of chargeable days, each remaining chargeable day is charged at its day rate together with any per-day addition, and that storage is added to the posted recovery expenses not yet removed or settled; the total is rounded to the cent.

The posted recovery expenses not yet removed or settled are the expenses posted on the case less those removed and less those already settled, never below zero.

## Steps of the figure

1. Take the posted expenses not yet removed or settled.
2. Fix the end date: the payment date, or the latest earliest sale date stated in any notice of intent to sell on the case if that date is earlier.
3. Count the days held, from the day after the recovery date through the end date.
4. Deduct the class free days; floor at zero; limit to the class maximum.
5. Charge each chargeable day at the class storage fee per day and add the storage to step 1; round to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Posted and unsettled expenses of 800.00; recovery on 3 June; payment on 13 June; no notice states an earlier date; a day fee of 10.00 and 2 class free days. Days held: 4 June through 13 June, 10 days; chargeable days 8; storage 80.00; payment 880.00.

If instead a notice on the case stated 9 June as the earliest sale date, the end date would be 9 June: 6 days held, 4 chargeable, storage 40.00, payment 840.00.
